svg.aria-label: Terraform-ia architecture: change, checks, review, merge and manual deploy
svg.text: From a change to a deploy
Code decides what runs and whether a change passes. The AI only explains. Merging never touches AWS.
Why it is safe to open it to others
• Code decides pass or fail; the AI never decides and never sees source files.
• Fork pull requests get no secrets and no AI.
• Each branch has its own AWS account, and the account guard stops a mismatch.
